properties.name: palmela
properties.legal: DO Palmela / DO Setubal: concelho of Palmela in full, plus freguesias of Montijo (Canha, Santo Isidro de Pegoes) and Setubal (Gambia-Pontes-Alto da Guerra, Sao Sebastiao). Concelho-level union.
